16:73.text: And they worship besides Allāh that which does not possess for them
provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and

16:74.text: So do not assert similarities to Allāh.
Indeed, Allāh knows and you do not know.

16:75.text: Allāh presents an example: a slave
owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to Allāh! But most of them do not know.

16:76.text: And Allāh presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path?

16:77.text: And to Allāh belongs the unseen
of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.

16:78.text: And Allāh has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and hearts
that perhaps you would be grateful.

16:79.text: Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except Allāh. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
